title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, maker settings, credit-allocation call and consumption-reporting call are supported by the sources checked. Independent searches also support its narrowly stated documentation gaps; no correction is required.
